issues.detail: The Hebrew 'כִּנְפֹל בָּהֶם בַּתְּחִלָּה' means 'when some of them fall at the beginning' (referring to the men of Israel/those with Absalom), but the Vietnamese 'khi một số người của chúng ta ngã xuống lúc đầu' adds 'của chúng ta' (of us/our people), which is not in the Hebrew and changes the referent from 'them' (Absalom's followers) to 'our people' (David's side). This is a substantive addition that alters who is falling.
